offer.text: Something has been picking off the flock at the edge of the village every night this week. Stand where the fires are and put six of them down.

accept.text: Do not chase them into the dark. That is how they get you.

decline.text: Then we lose another ewe tonight.

in_progress.text: Stay by the village. That is where they come.

ready.text: Six. And the flock is whole.

complete.text: Sleep in tomorrow. You have earned an hour of it.

failed.text: Dawn, and they are still out there. We move the flock.
